item.text: {"paper_id":"paper115","profile_id":"oncology","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Overall, our study delineates the antigenic hierarchy and makeup of HPV-specific humoral responses in HPV+ HNC, both intratumorally and systemically, thus providing a framework for future biomarker as well as next-generation therapeutics development.","rationale":"The study directly examines tumor-specific immune responses in head and neck cancer, characterizing intratumoral antibody-secreting cells and systemic antibodies with explicit relevance to cancer biomarker and therapeutic development.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
